name: File browser window
oneLiner: a smoked-glass file browser window rises in 3D; the selection walks down the folder column a row at a time and lands on one folder, which swells and opens: its files wipe into the next column, a glowing box draws round them and a leader drops into a white caption card that names what they are
say: when the speaker points at files on their own machine ('it reads everything in this folder', 'I keep all my scripts here'): the selection lands on the folder as they name it, the card lands on what the files are. Set folders, target (one of them), files and label
